Objects move according to the forces acting upon them, not some "path of least resistance". There's only one predominant force acting on the collapsing mass of the buildings - gravity pulling things towards the surface. In the case of the collapse of the WTC towers, there was enough damage from debris and fires that the structural supports in parts of the building were seriously weakened and compromised. Once enough supports gave way for a collapse to trigger, the remaining building didn't have the structural integrity to hold up against the collapsing mass above.
